_comment: How Petpooja's menu categories roll up into the three groups Pranjay reads.
Kept as data, not code, because the menu changes and this is a commercial
judgement he may want to overrule. Every category present in the day's data
must appear in exactly one group; anything unlisted falls into 'Other' and is
named in the report so it can never be lost silently.
Rakhi Cakes sits under 'Rakhi collection', NOT under 'Cakes': the groups are
mutually exclusive so the four shares add to 100, and the occasion view is the
one asked for. The report states what Cakes would be if it were moved back.

overlap_note.Rakhi Cakes: counted in Rakhi collection; would add to Cakes if moved
